title: Cloudflare zone traffic per project

metrics.name: web.requests_1d
metrics.label: запросов/сут
metrics.means: Every HTTP request Cloudflare served for the project's zones on the last complete UTC day, from the GraphQL httpRequests1dGroups dataset. Includes bots and assets — it measures load, not audience; the audience is web.visitors_1d beside it.

metrics.name: web.visitors_1d
metrics.label: визитёров/сут
metrics.means: Cloudflare's unique-visitor estimate for the last complete UTC day, summed over the project's zones. The role lets core surfaces ask 'which projects have an audience' without naming this plugin — the same seam release.count uses.

why: Measure daily edge requests and estimated visitors across explicitly configured Cloudflare accounts. Attribute zones to projects through the private registry so usage follows declared ownership; unmapped zones remain visible as diagnostics.
